design: Two independent-context guided tasks followed by a separate fresh-context assessor. No unguided controls.

trials.mode: English proposed revision with separate author questions

writer_inputs: One fictional request and frozen standalone skill with its references. No parent history, memory, other outputs, rubric, other repository files, or network access permitted.
assessor_inputs: Only rubric, requests, saved answers, and relative-path execution records. No skills, parent conclusions, memory, or network.
runtime: Same configured Codex host. No model override was requested or set. Exact model and tool versions were not captured.
preservation: Writer and assessor outputs are saved unedited. Execution records are self-reports rather than independent proof of all tool use.
limits: Two fictional cases and two skill entrypoints, not the complete library or a whole-paper study.
No controlled estimate of improvement, repeated sampling, cross-model validation, or AI-authorship detection.
No empirical validation of fictional research, rendered document, or real submission.
